newsitem.title: USA: U.S. retail spending rises - Telecheck.
newsitem.headline: U.S. retail spending rises - Telecheck.

text.p: Same-store retail sales rose 3.7 percent for the first 10 days of the holiday shopping period, according to data compiled by check acceptance company, TeleCheck Services.

Telecheck said that the data are based on a year-over-year, same-store comparison of the dollar volume of authorized checks written by consumers at more than 20,000 of TeleCheck's 160,000 subscribing locations.
Telecheck is a subsidiary of First Data Corp.
